sections.label: Evening ERP on CTE
sections.summary: Evening ERP on the northbound CTE keeps speeds at the lower end of the target, with speeds below 45 km/h between 6.30 pm and 7.00 pm.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Even with the evening ERP along the northbound Central Expressway (CTE), current traffic speeds are at the lower end of the targeted speed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: In fact, speeds dropped below 45 kilometres per hour between 6.30 pm and 7.00 pm.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Page: 25 If we remove the evening ERP, we will see even slower speeds and more traffic congestion.

sections.label: ERP fee setting and speed data
sections.summary: ERP fee setting at each quarterly adjustment relies on machine-generated speed data, which have not yet justified a reduction.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: As I use CTE often enough, whether speeds improve or deteriorate, I have first-hand knowledge.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: But for ERP fee setting at each quarterly adjustment, we rely on the speed data which machines generate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: As I have said, those data have not yet justified a reduction.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: But we hope that maybe with, for example, the new interchange which the Member talked about, speeds may enter the targeted range in a very definitive way – then there will be scope for adjustments.
